question: How close can a location-and-context xG model get to Understat's, with what Gold carries? (CLAUDE.md §8 #3)
excludes: penalties and own goals (feat_shots); see the report's penalties block
citation: features built from the Gold snapshot exported 2026-09-20T13:41:36+00:00, matches 2024-08-15 to 2026-09-19 (3,733 matches, 94,034 shots)
selected_on: validation folds 2024-11 to 2025-05, lowest log loss
missing_from_gold: Gold carries no last_action — the action before the shot (cross, through ball, rebound), which Understat parses and its model uses. Part 1 has it in Silver as last_action; it is not in Gold's fact_shots. Every gap to Understat below includes what that column would explain (CLAUDE.md §5, L10).
limitations: Gold carries no last_action — the action before the shot (cross, through ball, rebound), which Understat parses and its model uses. Part 1 has it in Silver as last_action; it is not in Gold's fact_shots. Every gap to Understat below includes what that column would explain (CLAUDE.md §5, L10).
Understat's xG is the benchmark, never an input (L9).
Penalties are not modelled; own goals are not shots.
